directive.quote: Repair the existing intake and ai-job lifecycle so authorized incoming work reaches a checked requested outcome and bounded owned recovery, using current shared stage and CAS owners.

preserve: The existing task state transitions and compare-and-set writes against the task value just read
One claim owner and bounded recovery when a result or continuation is refused
allowed_deltas: One kind of work: a task names its assignees as record ids of anyone (a person, an AI, a workflow, a raccoon), and a handoff is the hand-on move, a change of assignees
Require declared acceptance and a checked requested outcome before finishing a task
Carry the original claim fence and owned retry boundary across attempts; keep continuation bounded and explicit
banned_substitutions: Treating result text alone as proof that the requested outcome was checked
Reassigning a claimed task to another owner during a retry
Giving any kind of record its own rules (an AI-only or person-only take, give or finish)

baseline.note: Same-file snapshot of the AI job module before this port (its path was tools/hand-work-to-ais/read-data/ai-work.mjs, removed by the same landing). task-moves.mjs is a new file ported from it, not a byte copy; the test in test/task-moves.test.mjs is the proof.
